title: Restore Vaporize dependency resolution after relocation
description: Vaporize dependency resolution must complete from its relocated swift-universal product repository. The original SwiftSyntax constraint conflict is resolved; Windows resolution now fails while checking out a swift-log revision.

historicalContent.expectedBehavior: Vaporize resolves and tests from its canonical swift-universal path in both default and SPM_USE_LOCAL_DEPS modes.
currentEvidence: swift package dump-package succeeds after replacing the stale swift-universal/swift-universal relative paths with repository-root-derived paths.
wrkstrm-core common-service was upgraded to swift-syntax 602.0.0 and its 26 tests passed in commit cfc92f08830e3ce44f9cdc14a970d0ed78f5ef86.

Default-mode resolution combines revision 30cfcd8df00eab82f3af0b165f61a20622830ec5 from wrkstrm-upstreams/swift-log with the apple/swift-log URL, so checkout fails because Apple does not contain that tree.

With SPM_USE_LOCAL_DEPS=1 and VAPORIZE_DISABLE_SWIFTLY=1, dependency resolution succeeds and the complete Windows build finishes, while SwiftPM warns that the local fork and apple/swift-log share the swift-log identity.
acceptanceCriteria: TranslateCatalogCore and common-service admit one compatible SwiftSyntax release line.
Give apple/swift-log and the workstream fork one unambiguous package-identity strategy across common-log and common-process transitive dependencies.
Resolve and build in both default and SPM_USE_LOCAL_DEPS modes without an invalid mixed-source lockfile.
Run Vaporize tests from private/product-lines/vaporize on Windows.
Run dependency resolution in default and local-dependency modes.
Do not bypass the conflict by removing either dependency or suppressing SwiftPM diagnostics.
historicalContent.scopeBoundary: Coordinate the owning common-log, common-process, and upstream package manifests; do not suppress SwiftPM diagnostics or replace the temporal fork release with an unrelated Apple revision.
